findings: Terminal slots are the union of original persisted generations and explicit failed-proposal records with downstream_eval_submitted=false; island copies do not create evaluated slots.
Durable failure.json is inspected even if native best-effort attempt-log insertion did not complete.
Resume excludes both persisted and terminal-failed generations from accepted-proposal restoration and skips preserved terminal failures when a rewound cursor reaches them.
Saved accepted proposals retain native source/lineage and checkpoint evaluator reuse; incomplete proposal evidence is archived before a new attempt.

Shortlisting requires all three registered searches complete with a valid seed and exactly slots 0 through 29 accounted for; no validation/final simulations were executed and no final seeds were generated by this audit.
scope: Read-only code and active native-state review. Prepared focused tests cover synthetic terminal failures; no active search was interrupted or restarted to manufacture a recovery test.
